reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported database: includes/connect.php opens a SQLite database file. Deployz hosts PostgreSQL and MySQL only.
reviews.reason: The production image installs only pdo_sqlite, and no shown setting selects PostgreSQL or MySQL instead of the SQLite database file.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume ./db:/var/www/html/db (docker-compose.yaml wallos), volume ./logos:/var/www/html/images/uploads/logos (docker-compose.yaml wallos)
reviews.reason: The volumes keep the SQLite database and the uploaded logos across restarts, and no shown setting moves this data to a managed database or S3.
